comparison.objective: Move five fragile upright tiles into a box in as few trips as possible.
comparison.physical_skill: Batch grasping and transport of multiple fragile plates while preventing slip and tip-over.
comparison.success_condition: All tiles upright in the box without any fall or tip; score depends on trip count.
comparison.reason: Batch transport and risk/efficiency tradeoffs do not test tool alignment, controlled hammering, fracture, or recovery of generated fragments.
